title: HELP
lyrics_plain: She's taken my time   Convince me she's fine   But when she leaves I'm not so sure   It's always the same   She's playing her game   And when she goes I feel to blame   Why won't she say she needs me?   I know she's not as strong as she seems   Why don't I see her cry for help?   Why don't I feel her cry for help?   Why don't I hear her cry for help?   I wandered around the streets of this town trying to find sense of it all   The rain on my face, it covers the trace of all the tears I'd had to waste   Why must we hide emotions?   Why must we never break down and cry?   All that I need is to cry for help   Somebody please hear me cry for help   All I can do is cry for help   No need to feel ashamed   Release the pain   Cry for help   Cry for help is all I need   All I need is a cry for help   Cry for help is all I need
